However, the task requires at least 3 alarms set for the day before each event, and only 2 were created (Flight SFO to JFK DL1358 at 4:36 AM and Project Alpha meeting 10am at 8:36 AM). Additionally, the alarms were not set for the day before the events - they appear to be set at the current time without proper date configuration (iOS Clock app doesn't support date-specific alarms natively, but the agent didn't attempt to set at least 3). The document also contains 'Start typing here.' prepended to the content. The agent did not check the SkyTrip app thoroughly enough - it navigated to My Trips via a seat selection action but did capture all 4 required flights. The StayFinder check was incomplete - the agent navigated to StayFinder but ended up in what appeared to be TicketBox's browse screen, though the Trips tab showed Catalina booking. Overall, the main failures are: only 2 alarms created (need at least 3), and the alarms don't have proper date targeting for the day before events.
